title: One-arm Hang Prep
texts: Shoulder shrugs and one arm isometric holds using a pull up bar or jug hold

This workout is designed to increase strength in the muscles which control and stabilise your scapular. This is a great workout to build up to one arm hanging exercises. You can do this at a lower intensity to warm up before one arm fingerboarding or at a higher intensity after.

Complete 4 sets of 5 reps of shoulder shrugs. Rest 60 seconds between each set. 

Complete 4 sets of 5 second isometric hangs on each arm with your shoulders engaged throughout. Alternate arms on each set which allows 60 seconds rest between sets for the same arm

You can increase the load using additional weights in a rucksack or attached to a climbing harness. Only aim to reach a sub maximal intensity which is challenging but not close to failure. 

Focus on squeezing your abs and glutes throughout to maintain good form.
